articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Chainalysis estimates $457B in taxable crypto activity, says CARF misses most
articles.description: The blockchain analytics firm said just 14% of the onchain activity it identified is covered by the OECD’s international crypto tax-reporting framework.

articles.title: SEC sends crypto custody rule overhaul to White House for review
articles.description: The securities regulator’s crypto custody overhaul could clarify how investment advisers and funds hold digital assets for clients as the proposal moves through review.

articles.title: 77% of Americans see crypto in retirement plans as risky: Survey
articles.description: A new survey finds broad skepticism toward crypto in workplace retirement plans as US policymakers move to expand access to alternative assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $78K as stocks, gold fall on higher US PCE Inflation data
articles.description: Bitcoin stayed away from challenging $80,000 after July US PCE inflation data came in slightly higher than anticipated, pressuring gold and risk assets.

articles.title: Protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution to solve scaling bottlenecks
articles.description: CTDG Dev Hub participant’s protocol upgrade decouples consensus from execution, allowing network nodes to reach agreement on blocks before transaction execution completes.

articles.title: SEC’s proposed crypto rules probably won’t spark new ICO boom
articles.description: The SEC’s ‘regulation crypto assets’ proposals could create early-round FOMO. But some tokens may still fall into the no-man’s land between security and non-security.

articles.title: Students want crypto classes but learn on social media: OKX survey
articles.description: A separate review found only about 28% of accredited US business schools offered blockchain courses, despite strong demand in the OKX poll.

articles.title: Bernstein forecasts Bitcoin to reclaim $125K by late 2026 ahead of cycle peak
articles.description: Bernstein expects Bitcoin to reclaim $125,000 by late 2026, before reaching $300,000 in 2029 under its base case, with a bull case of $500,000.

articles.title: Taurus links digital asset platforms to Swift’s blockchain ledger
articles.description: Taurus expects first institutional clients to connect in days, with initial DLT transactions through its platforms expected within weeks.

articles.title: Supply absorption ‘key question’ as Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K: Analysis
articles.description: Bitcoin struggled to establish support at $80,000 as investor cohorts all returned to net profitability.

articles.title: Japan weighs blockchain fast lane for securities cash settlement
articles.description: The FSA, Finance Ministry, BOJ and financial institutions plan to study the infrastructure and produce a development plan by early 2027.

articles.title: Kalshi’s $1.5B equity offering is three-quarters sold at $1.12B
articles.description: The Form D lists 71 investors and says Kalshi is relying on an exemption that allows certain private offerings without SEC registration.

articles.title: Revolut rolls out euro stablecoin in 3 European markets
articles.description: The Bridge-issued EURR token will support multiple blockchains and external wallets, with wider EEA availability expected this year.

articles.title: Tornado Cash developer Roman Storm’s retrial delayed to April 2027
articles.description: Judge Katherine Polk Failla adjourned the retrial in light of Storm’s pending motion for acquittal and related request for a continuance.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs tear through 2026 outflows in 7-day hot streak
articles.description: The funds are $390 million short of October 2025’s inflow total after cutting their year-to-date net outflow deficit by more than half.

articles.title: US state banking groups plan nationwide blockchain network for 2027
articles.description: BankChain joins a growing field of bank-led networks building shared infrastructure for tokenized deposits and onchain payments.

articles.title: World Liberty Financial launches USD1 natively on Canton Network
articles.description: USD1 is the sixth-largest stablecoin, with a market capitalization of more than $4 billion, according to industry data.

articles.title: Bitcoin enters ‘initial phase’ of new bull market, but $83K remains key: CryptoQuant
articles.description: CryptoQuant says Bitcoin’s 24% rally has flipped key market indicators bullish, though rising profit-taking could bring near-term turbulence.

articles.title: Solana transactions hit record 4.2B as SOL rallies 40%
articles.description: Tokenized real-world assets on Solana are nearing $4 billion as network activity accelerates alongside a broader recovery in crypto markets.

articles.title: Strategy’s $66B Bitcoin machine hinges on capital markets, not BTC price: Report
articles.description: Strategy’s biggest risk may not be a Bitcoin crash, but losing access to the capital markets that help it service $1.76 billion in annual obligations.

articles.title: Bitwise launches self-custodied tokenized stock portfolios with Coinbase
articles.description: Bitwise’s new portfolios automatically rebalance Coinbase tokenized stocks while allowing eligible non-US investors to keep the assets in their own wallets.

articles.title: DGrid AI token jumps 93% after launch as decentralized AI network goes live
articles.description: DGAI nearly doubled in its first day of trading as DGrid expands its distributed AI inference network and rolls out hardware for its personal AI agent.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips from $80K as gold cools with falling US bond yields
articles.description: Bitcoin bulls battled for control of the $80,000 zone as gold came off its highest levels since mid-May on falling US bond yields.

articles.title: Arcus launches tokenized perp positions on Robinhood Chain
articles.description: Arcus introduced transferable ERC-20 tokens for perpetual positions and lets tokenized stocks back leveraged trades without requiring users to sell their holdings.

articles.title: Hugging Face hack exposes the open-weight AI cybersecurity paradox
articles.description: Hugging Face relies on open weight Chinese models to defend itself from rogue AI agents. But a lack of safety guardrails makes those models potentially dangerous too.

articles.title: Chainalysis-led operation flags 7,700 accounts in child abuse probe
articles.description: Operation Lighthouse generated 14,300 investigative leads across 11 crypto exchanges and payment services and flagged over 7,700 suspect accounts.

articles.title: India plans first tokenized bonds using wholesale CBDC: Report
articles.description: India plans to test tokenized corporate bonds in a September pilot, with state-controlled REC issuing the debt and select investors using wholesale CBDC payments.

articles.title: Shipyard winds down IPFS work after Protocol Labs ends funding
articles.description: The funding loss leaves InterPlanetary File System software without dedicated maintainers and puts the future of key public services in Protocol Labs’ hands.

articles.title: BTC RSI bullish divergence draws 2022 comparisons as analysis weighs new price trend
articles.description: Bitcoin price analysis eyes the potential end of its current macro downtrend based on weekly RSI signals.
